
// Template literal with ${} interpolation
const greeting = `Hello, ${window.location.hostname}!
This is a multi-line
template literal.`;

// Multi-line string via concatenation
const message = "First line\n" +
  "Second line\n" +
  "Third line";

// JSON blob
const config = {
  "apiEndpoint": "/api/v1",
  "timeout": 5000,
  "features": {
    "darkMode": true,
    "notifications": false
  },
  "allowedOrigins": [
    "https://example.com",
    "https://app.example.com"
  ]
};

// Another template literal with nested expressions
const rendered = `
  <div class="${config.features.darkMode ? 'dark' : 'light'}">
    ${greeting}
  </div>
`;

console.log(rendered);
